links.outcome: Patient recognition that educational video with clinician avatars was AI-generated
links.effect: Patients generally did not recognize the video was AI-generated (4.3 ± 1.1 on Likert scale); they would watch more AI videos (4.7 ± 0.7) and recommend them (4.7 ± 0.65).
links.quote: Additionally, patients generally did not recognize that the video was AI-generated (4.3 ± 1.1), responded that they would watch more AI-generated videos in the future (4.7 ± 0.7), and would recommend AI-generated content to others (4.7 ± 0.65).

unlisted_practices: Using AI-generated avatar videos of real clinicians for patient preoperative education
Assessing patient perceptions and educational value of AI-generated video content

screen.reason: The study evaluated generative AI-produced educational video content directly deployed to real patients undergoing strabismus surgery, measuring their perceptions and comprehension. It evaluates the tool itself rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or guardrail practice.
